blocks.text: PHOENIX — Devin Booker scored 30 points, Dillon Brooks added 24 and the Phoenix Suns snapped a four-game losing streak by beating the Orlando Magic 117-104 in the NBA on Thursday night. The Suns won a night after falling at home to Portland. The Magic have dropped three straight. READ: NBA preview: Devin Booker, Suns look to build on last season’s success Booker and Brooks hit back-to-back 3s midway through the third quarter to extend the Suns’ lead to 78-60 and they pushed that advantage to 96-73 heading into the fourth.
